name: ambiguous-risk-supplement
filingText: PROSPECTUS SUPPLEMENT Epsilon BioPharma, Inc. (Nasdaq: EPSN) This prospectus supplement updates recent developments. The FDA has placed a clinical hold on our Phase 2 oncology trial pending additional toxicology data. We also received a Nasdaq notice regarding a stockholders' equity deficiency and may be subject to delisting if the deficiency is not cured. We may seek additional financing, but no offering terms are provided in this supplement.
